description:
Two conflicts with byte-identical parameters, so their tensions are exactly equal. A selector must still choose deterministically, and the tie-break must not depend on belief id ordering, dict iteration order, or insertion order — all three of which vary between runs and none of which is a reason to prefer one conflict over another.

This is the shape experiment 3 section 3.5 was bitten by: 46% of correctly-identified edges were destroyed by emission order, invisible in both the extractor output and the store, and found only by comparing the two.

expect.note: Structural. What the selector does with the tie is the dependent variable; that it does the SAME thing every time is the requirement.
